summary: Allow 15 seconds for SidebarTree scenario-mode story validations, preserving full forbidden-read checks while covering the expanded fixtures' measured 7.1-second CI render cost.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No product behavior change. Story validation still commits and unmounts the complete tree. Only stories in SidebarTree.stories.tsx receive the file-scoped 15-second allowance; all other stories retain Vitest's 5-second default to expose regressions.
